pairs.why: Both use the same cyan-to-blue background and navy fixture with yellow, cyan and red lamps, and neither picks up the real card's purple and magenta shift.
B's background is a calmer mid blue without the glowing cyan center in A, and its darker red and orange underside matches the real canopy's shadow side.
Both are more saturated cyan-to-royal-blue than the real card's muted teal-indigo, and neither has the purple rim glow. A also adds an orange band as an extra accent.
The real card is almost all muted wood tan. B shows more wood and less loud orange stripe wall than A, though both are warmer and more chromatic than the real card.
A's frame is mostly turquoise water with orange wood and a little sand, as on the real card. B gives a large flat sky-blue area and a bigger sand share that the real card lacks.
Both have a yellow-lime green background with an orange ring, while the real card's background is cooler mint-green. Neither gives a reason to choose.
B's sand is more muted and its leaves have cool blue-green shadows like the real palm. A's sand and trunk are hotter, saturated orange and its magenta is deeper.
Both swap the real card's deep saturated blue water for light cyan and use similar beige sand, so neither is closer on color.
